title: Perpetual Clementine
subtitle: Turn it. Peel it. Take a little break.
peelHint: Pull a strip away from the fruit to peel it. Turn to reach the other side.
eatHint: Click to eat a segment, or hold and sweep across several. Release to eat.
rotateHint: Right-drag to turn · Arrows rotate · Space peels / eats · R resets
keyboard: Arrow keys turn the clementine. Space removes a peel strip or eats a segment. R starts a fresh clementine. Escape cancels a gesture or closes the panel.
